classification.difficultyReason: Subtract vectors, calculate an exact magnitude and determine a fourth-quadrant inclination.

content.prompt:
Find the magnitude and direction of $\underset{\sim}{b}-\underset{\sim}{a}$ if $\underset{\sim}{a}=\mathbf{i}+7\mathbf{j}$ and $\underset{\sim}{b}=4\mathbf{i}-9\mathbf{j}$.

Give magnitude in exact form and direction to the nearest degree.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}\underset{\sim}{b}-\underset{\sim}{a}&=(4\mathbf{i}-9\mathbf{j})-(\mathbf{i}+7\mathbf{j})=3\mathbf{i}-16\mathbf{j}\\ \left|\underset{\sim}{b}-\underset{\sim}{a}\right|&=\sqrt{3^2+(-16)^2}=\sqrt{9+256}=\sqrt{265}\\ \tan\theta&=-\frac{16}{3}\\ \theta&=\tan^{-1}\left(-\frac{16}{3}\right)\approx-79.4^\circ\end{aligned}$$
The vector is in the fourth quadrant.
$$\begin{aligned}\text{Direction}&=360^\circ-79.4^\circ\\ &\approx281^\circ\end{aligned}$$
